svg.text: FIG-R10 · Reverse-anchor categories: where each RV category starts and which layers its rows anchor to
Source: R8 Reverse Anchor Register v0-1 §3.1–§3.19 (Sub-layer column parsed) and §7 row counts
Columns ordered by home level (R8 §3 opening paragraphs), top of stack left. Total 301 RV rows (R8 §7 states 301). Dot = rows of that category whose Sub-layer cell names that layer (size ~ √count);

a row naming several layers counts in each. Dashed box = home level. Arrow = descent to the lowest anchored layer. RV-SCF has no Sub-layer column: placed at L5.2 per §3.10. 'n/s' = no sub-layer stated (MET, part of GOV).
Source: R8 Reverse Anchor Register v0-1 §3, §7. Status legend per R6 header / R8 §0 (M, Dv, Ds, E, S, I). Generated by make_phase2_figures.py; first-pass (v0-1) inputs.
